title: Watavyu project
description: A Watavyu project file (.watavyu.json): a spreadsheet of annotation columns and media columns. Rules this schema cannot express, which Watavyu also enforces: column names are unique; a coded cell has one value per code of its column; a video cell's offset is its onset plus its source's duration.

time.description: A time in HH:MM:SS:mmm. Hours have at least two digits and do not wrap at 24.

signedTime.description: A time in HH:MM:SS:mmm that may be negative, with a leading minus sign. There is no negative zero.

annotationColumn.description: A column whose cells hold one value per code.

codes.description: The names of the column's codes, in order. A column with no codes holds timing only.

cells.description: The column's cells. Watavyu writes them in time order.

annotationCell.description: An annotation cell. New cells are point cells, with the two times equal. An offset before the onset is allowed; Watavyu flags it in the spreadsheet.

values.description: One value per code, in the order of the column's codes. An empty value is "".

mediaColumn.description: A column that is one media window. Its cells are clips: each shows its source from its onset for the source's duration. Gaps show blank frames; where clips overlap, the later one wins.

hidden.description: Whether the media window is hidden.

locked.description: Whether the clips are protected from being dragged.

clip.description: A media clip. It may start before time zero, when a recording began before the annotated session (a stopgap while the video controller window exists; see AGENTS.md).

offset.description: The onset plus the source's duration. Written for readers; it cannot be set.

source.description: The media file and what Watavyu last read from it. The file wins when they disagree.

file.description: The file's path: relative to the folder holding the project file, or absolute. Separators are /.
